content: Namo Guru.In the stainless realm of the essence of awakening,The self-arisen Victor, the perfectly complete Buddha,Who turned the peerless wheel of Dharma,To the Lord of Sages, 'Bri-gung Rin-chen, I pay homage.From the lotus mouth of that supreme holy one,The excellent, uncommon vajra speech,The essence of nectar, the root of the forty supplements,Bestows the glory of happiness and joy upon those who desire it.The teachings of all Victors of the directions and times are one;All vehicles and tenet systems are dependently originated.The eighty thousand heaps of Dharma were taught as antidotes to mental afflictions;Within each one, the twelve branches of the scriptures are complete.Likewise, all three collections are included within each one.All of samsara and nirvana are contained within the five perfections.The common and the uncommon belong to the Abhidharma collection.Non-Buddhists and Bön have no opportunity to see the truth.It is possible that they possess some aspects conducive to liberation,Yet vows and compassion exist even among non-Buddhists.Through the Vehicle of Characteristics, one attains buddhahood in a single lifetime;By the procedure of Dharma and practice, buddhahood is one.The three vows become increasingly more rigorous;One proceeds through the essence of the path of accumulation up to the ultimate stage.Because they possess the cause, listeners and self-realized buddhas become buddhas;Because it is free from elaborations, it is maintained that samsara has no end.All Dharma teachings are included within each of the three vows;The root of all schools is the four scriptural transmissions.Even when one damages them in a dream, faults ensue;It has happened that one who attained the pure stages went to the lower realms.If one commits the cause, even one on the tenth stage will fall;The marvelous practice is the yogi’s inner feast offering.All meditative concentration is vajra-like;The Secret Mantra belongs to the three collections, or is their essence.Even if one is realized, one needs rituals, because the lineage is profound;Even through one deity, all activities are accomplished.The primary deity holds the characteristics of all deities;On the four occasions, it is never the case that the root pledges are allowed to be broken.Instantaneous entry into the deity is a profound key point;One must know it is accomplished from a gathering of interdependent factors.Austerity is a debasement because it labels the body as ordinary;Extensive rituals are necessary without differentiating the provisional and the definitive.If one is tamed by it, concise rituals are also accepted;The marvelous protective sphere is bodhicitta.Instructions on the channels and energies are more potent in the vinaya;By the power of blessings, one can also see the all-ground at other times.Channels, energies, and essential drops that are poisoned with impurities are profound;The gradual path of the Vajrayana is the three trainings.The six transcendent practices are the path for all three vehicles;The mutual pledges of the master and the disciple are the same in being equal.It is impossible that activities of a virtuous nature obscure mahamudra;All results of separation have causes.The mixing of the two spaces is the clear realization of listeners;It is profound to not hold the wind energies but to let them be loose.The unity of the consciousness, the guru, and the clear light is the supreme transference of consciousness;Buddha is the manifestation of bodhicitta.Thus his intention reaches the limit of space;This is not easy to understand even for those who have attained mastery.The winged lord of garuḍas, who stands before us,Traverses with the strong movement of his vast wisdom wings;Although the masters of the past have made this clear,I have added these supplements to benefit those of lower intellect.I have strung these verses like a garland of wish-fulfilling jewels,A necklace of delight for the wise to wear;By the blazing splendor of the thousands of virtues of this well-done work,May the darkness of beings’ obscurations be instantaneously uprooted,And may they attain the fortune to enjoy the nectar of the blossoming lotus gardenOf the two gatherings of scriptures and realization.This was composed by the noble guru Dharma Sūrya.
